external/com.stripe.stripeterminal.external.models/Charge/CardPresent

CardPresent

@Serializable
data class CardPresent : Serializable

Transaction details captured for a card-present payment on this Charge.

This is the charge.payment_method_details.card_present or charge.payment_method_details.interac_present snapshot. For reusable instrument details on an expanded PaymentMethod, see PaymentMethod.CardPresent.

For more information, see the official Stripe docs: Card present

Use of this SDK is subject to the Stripe Terminal Terms: https://stripe.com/terminal/legal

The cardholder name as read from the card. May include alphanumeric characters, special characters and first/last name separator (/). In some cases, the cardholder name may not be available depending on how the issuer has configured the card. Cardholder name is typically not available on swipe or contactless payments.
